icons.label: Home
icons.meaning: Home or top-level destination. Do not substitute for Back.

review.note: Retained the roof, doorway, and body pair. The silhouette remains a useful family reference without requiring all icons to match its area. At 16 px, the roof/body has a small documented overshoot beyond the nominal 1.5 px padding.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Menu
icons.meaning: Open navigation or a menu.

review.note: Retained the three bars after comparing crisp and strictly centered micro variants. The original 12 px outline raster is clearer. The 0.5 px optical offset is intentional. A larger clickable area and an accessible name are still required.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: More
icons.meaning: Additional actions in an overflow menu.

review.note: Retained crisp 1 px micro dots rather than replacing them with blurred centered marks. The 12 px offset is intentional and documented; larger masters remain balanced. Use 16 px or larger for an overflow control, with an accessible More options name.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Search
icons.meaning: Find content. A heavier lens still has an open center.

review.note: Retained the open octagonal lens and diagonal handle. The lens stays transparent in both weights; filling it would change the metaphor. The 12 px filled lens is relatively dense; use a label or a clearly identified search field.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Grid
icons.meaning: Open an application grid or change to grid view.

review.note: Reduced the 24 px footprint and increased separation at 16 px. Four frames no longer dominate as strongly. Native opening widths are 2 / 2 / 3 px. Four repeated cells naturally paint more area than one arrow. Equal area is not a target.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow left
icons.meaning: Literal left arrow; application chooses its navigation role.

review.note: Reflected from the locked right-arrow geometry. Stroke width is not rescaled.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow right
icons.meaning: A literal right arrow. Navigation direction must be chosen by the application.

review.note: Removed post-stroke stretching; rebuilt the arrow on shared centerlines. Actual native stroke width now follows the action-weight tokens. The filled arrow can have slightly larger painted bounds. Retain a text label when the destination is not obvious.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow up
icons.meaning: Literal up arrow, not Upload.

review.note: Quarter-turn of the locked right arrow, preserving native stroke width.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow down
icons.meaning: Literal down arrow, not Download.

review.note: Quarter-turn of the locked right arrow, preserving native stroke width.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow up right
icons.meaning: Open another destination. Keep a visible action label.

review.note: Shortened the large corner arms and removed post-stroke stretching. Less top/right mass; one diagonal and a 90° arrowhead, with unchanged external-destination meaning. Do not mirror this automatically for right-to-left layouts without checking the intended meaning.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Chevron left
icons.meaning: Compact left direction. Navigation semantics stay in the component.

review.note: Mirrored from Chevron right. The opposite pair shares exact construction.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Chevron right
icons.meaning: Compact right direction. Not an external-link marker.

review.note: A single 90-degree bend on shared native centerlines. Shorter field than an arrow.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Chevron up
icons.meaning: Up direction or collapse, with a label.

review.note: Rotated from Chevron right without stretching expanded paths.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Chevron down
icons.meaning: Down direction or disclosure, with a label.

review.note: Rotated from Chevron right without stretching expanded paths.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Plus
icons.meaning: Add or create. Distinct from expand and zoom-in.

review.note: Retained the existing simple cross after native-pixel comparison. The 12 px outline uses a half-pixel optical offset for a crisp 1 px stem. Forcing the same center made it softer. A 0.5 px micro center difference is documented, not a layout shift. Keep the button box fixed.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Minus
icons.meaning: Decrease or subtract. Not a destructive delete substitute.

review.note: Shares the Plus horizontal stem, including its micro optical adjustment.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Check
icons.meaning: Confirm or communicate completion.

review.note: Removed post-stroke stretching; preserved the asymmetric two-arm check. Its deliberately shorter height and exact stroke width balance it with other actions. Do not stretch it into a square to match Home.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Close
icons.meaning: Dismiss or close. Do not use as a destructive delete substitute.

review.note: Retained the clean two-diagonal construction. Two crossing strokes need no decorative opening or extra cuts. Diagonal antialiasing is expected. Keep a visible or accessible Close label.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Edit
icons.meaning: A pencil for editing content.

review.note: Two separated pencil parts. Enlarged shaft counter, no decorative eraser lines.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Copy
icons.meaning: Create a duplicate or copy to clipboard.

review.note: Retained the offset sheets and subordinate rear contour. The rear sheet does not become a second filled block; the front sheet carries the style change. Keep the duplicate action named in the product.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Trash
icons.meaning: Delete. Confirm destructive behavior at the application level.

review.note: Opened the lid/body gap and removed unnecessary internal slots. The gap is 1 / 1.5 / 2 px. Compact outlines stay empty; larger forms use one slot. Use a label and the appropriate product-level confirmation for destructive actions.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Refresh
icons.meaning: Reload the current data. Not Undo or Redo.

review.note: One open angular cycle and one arrowhead. No double arrows or decorative cuts.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Filter
icons.meaning: A funnel that narrows a result set. Not generic adjustment controls.

review.note: One funnel silhouette. The narrow stem is intentionally solid in both appearances.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Sliders
icons.meaning: Adjust parameters. Not a funnel filter or gear glyph.

review.note: Two rails at every size; smaller 24 px field and handles; pixel-aligned 12 px construction. The 24 px artwork is 18 × 16 px, with 6 px handles and unchanged 2 px rails. Outline centers remain open. Use the canonical name Sliders. Settings, Adjust, and Filters are search aliases, not duplicate drawings.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Upload
icons.meaning: Transfer into a service.

review.note: Rebuilt the upward arrow and preserved the same baseline as Download. Independent native spacing prevents the heavier arrow from crowding the baseline. The upward point needs more top clearance than the flat end of Download.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Download
icons.meaning: Transfer out to this device.

review.note: Rebuilt the arrow without stretching and opened clearance above the baseline. The baseline and action stroke widths now follow the native weight tokens, including the filled micro version. Keep Upload and Download together as a matched directional pair.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Save
icons.meaning: A disk metaphor for committing changes. Not Bookmark or Download.

review.note: Clipped disk silhouette with native-size slots. No small label lines or tiny screws.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: File
icons.meaning: A document. Not a duplicate action.

review.note: Removed the internal fold elbow and extra lines. The clipped outer corner identifies the file. One content line remains only at 24 px, with 2 px clearance. At 12/16 px this is an intentionally simpler clipped document, not a scaled detailed drawing.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Folder
icons.meaning: A folder or grouped files.

review.note: Retained the tabbed silhouette and compact detail reduction. The 12 px master omits the filled header slit. No added decorative cuts are needed. Filled areas are intentional; do not normalize them to the area of line glyphs.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Link
icons.meaning: A link or related resource. Not external navigation by itself.

review.note: Redrew the chain as three deliberately separated parts at every size. Removed near-touching joins and the 16 px connectivity change. The heavier style uses a restrained 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 px stroke. Label the actual action: Copy URL, Open link, or Attach link are different operations.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Bookmark
icons.meaning: Save a reference for later. Different from saving changed data.

review.note: Reduced the oversized 16 px silhouette to a 13 px height. It now respects the normal compact vertical field while remaining narrower than a square icon. Bookmark means save a resource; keep it distinct from Star/favorite in product copy.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Star
icons.meaning: Favorite or rating, with context. Distinct from Focus.

review.note: Retained the five-point outline/filled silhouette. It is distinct from Focus. Its pointed key shape must not be forced into square-icon proportions. A small 16 px horizontal overshoot is intentional; test the favorite state in context.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Calendar
icons.meaning: A date or calendar.

review.note: Removed the narrow header divider and reduced the date details. Bindings plus one date at 12 px or two dates at 16/24 px preserve recognition with less clutter. The date mark count is a deliberate optical-size change, not data.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: User
icons.meaning: A person or profile.

review.note: Retained the octagonal head and cut shoulders. The head and body remain distinct in both styles, with no extra facial details. The small outlined head is only an identity cue; it is not a detailed avatar.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Chat
icons.meaning: A message or conversation.

review.note: Retained the message silhouette and micro detail removal. The tail remains the identifying feature. No content line is added at 12 px. The 16 px outline deliberately omits the line that appears as a cutout in the filled body.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Bell
icons.meaning: Notifications. Do not imply a warning or failure by shape alone.

review.note: Retained the crown, bell body, and detached clapper. The clapper gap remains open instead of adding visual mass by joining the parts. Pair the icon with notification text or a named control.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Warning
icons.meaning: A warning requiring a visible text label in every supported appearance and native size.

review.note: Locked geometry retained. Outline punctuation/frame gaps are below the nominal targets. Filled punctuation is an explicit optical exception at 16 and 24 px. The size-aware restriction record governs use; independent approval remains pending.

icons.label: Info
icons.meaning: Information about content or a status. Distinct from Help and Warning.

review.note: Octagonal frame with positive/negative information mark. Square punctuation.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Help
icons.meaning: Assistance or documentation. Distinct from information status.

review.note: Octagonal frame with a simplified question mark. Explicit native punctuation spacing.
review.usage: Visible label required at 12 px; contextual label recommended at other sizes.

icons.label: Lock
icons.meaning: Restricted access or locked content.

review.note: Retained the open shackle and contrasting body pair. The shackle stays open in both styles. Small outlines omit the keyhole rather than crowding the frame. Do not use a padlock alone to assert that a process is secure.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Shield
icons.meaning: Protection or policy. Pair with the actual status in text.

review.note: Shortened and lifted the 16/24 px body. Reduced low placement and edge pressure while keeping a stable, matching pair. A shield indicates a concept; visible text must describe the actual status.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Gear
icons.meaning: A gear settings metaphor. Sliders remains a separate adjustment glyph.

review.note: Eight simple teeth and one open hub. No concentric decorative rings.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Terminal
icons.meaning: A command interface. Not an ordinary next arrow.

review.note: Reduced the enclosing box and redrew the prompt with more clearance. A wider, lower window is less heavy than the old square; the underscore is omitted at compact sizes. The micro prompt is simplified. Prefer a labeled 16 px or larger developer-tool control.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Branch
icons.meaning: A branching relationship. Use a visible label, especially at 12 px.

review.note: Unified node contour weights; adjusted larger-node spacing and the 24 px footprint. All sizes keep one connected three-node structure. Outline node openings are 1 / 1.5 / 2 px. The 12 px outline remains dense. Label it, and prefer 16 px or larger for an action.
review.usage: Visible label required at 12 px; contextual label recommended at other sizes.

icons.label: Chart
icons.meaning: A bar chart or analytics view.

review.note: Retained the ascending bars after reviewing the 12 px raster. The micro outline keeps its optical half-pixel x offset for crisp verticals. Baselines match across weights. Do not force a heavier chart into the painted area of a single thin line.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Play
icons.meaning: Play media or start an operation. Do not auto-mirror in RTL.

review.note: Retained the triangle and matching transparent outline. Its optical right shift is deliberate. A triangular form must not be centered by painted area alone. An interior taper is not a failed spacing channel.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Pause
icons.meaning: Pause an operation. Do not use for stop.

review.note: Retained two regular/heavier solid bars. Hollowing the narrow bars would create fragile internal slots at small sizes. Do not interpret filled styling alone as playback state.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Focus
icons.meaning: Focus a region. Context is required; not a star or fullscreen symbol.

review.note: Shortened the corner brackets, reduced the larger footprint, and lightened the heavier variant. The center square stays distinct; the symbol is not Expand or a four-point Star. Product-dependent meaning. Use Focus selection or similarly specific text.
review.usage: Visible label required at 12 px; contextual label recommended at other sizes.
